components.title: eVault core (and the Provisioner)
components.one_line: The personal data store every entity owns: multi-tenant GraphQL/HTTP eVault API plus the provisioning API that creates eVaults; emits awareness packets and push notifications.
evidence: infrastructure/evault-core/src/core/protocol/graphql-server.ts:821 EMOVER_API_URL trusted to skip webhooks during migration
platforms/calendar/api/src/services/EVaultService.ts:85 PUBLIC_EVAULT_SERVER_URI (talks to eVault GraphQL directly, no web3-adapter)

components.title: W3ID library
components.one_line: Library that creates and resolves W3IDs, the persistent identifiers for users, devices, eVaults and envelopes.

components.title: signature-validator
components.one_line: Library that verifies a signature against the public key bound to an eName, resolving the eVault and key-binding certificates through the Registry.
evidence: infrastructure/signature-validator/src/index.ts:248 resolves eVault URL from the registry

platforms/blabsy/api/src/controllers/AuthController.ts:6 (and the same import in every platform AuthController: calendar:5, dreamsync:7, ecurrency:6, ereputation:6, esigner:7, evoting:7, file-manager:7, group-charter-manager:6, pictique:7)
cerberus does NOT import it: platforms/cerberus/client/package.json lists only web3-adapter

components.title: Web3 Adapter
components.one_line: Library each platform embeds to map its local tables to ontology schemas and sync them both ways with eVaults (mapping JSON + watcher + webhook).
evidence: platforms/*/api/src/web3adapter/watchers/subscriber.ts:9 imports web3-adapter (cerberus, dreamsync, ecurrency, ereputation, esigner, evoting, file-manager, group-charter-manager, pictique)
infrastructure/web3-adapter/src/evault/evault.ts:248 requests a platform token from registry /platforms/certification

infrastructure/web3-adapter/package.json:21 declares evault-core workspace:* but no source import of evault-core was found (only evault-core e2e imports web3-adapter dist: infrastructure/evault-core/src/e2e/evault-core.e2e.spec.ts:16)
dreamsync-api, ecurrency-api, ereputation-api import web3-adapter without declaring it in package.json (platforms/dreamsync/api/package.json)

components.title: eID Wallet
components.one_line: Tauri mobile wallet that holds the user's keys, provisions eVaults, signs w3ds://auth and w3ds://sign requests, votes and recovers identities.
evidence: infrastructure/eid-wallet/src/lib/global/controllers/evault.ts:9 imports wallet-sdk; :14 writes the User ontology profile
infrastructure/eid-wallet/src/routes/(public)/open-message/[globalId]/+page.svelte:48,60 opens messages in Pictique or Blabsy
every platform and service that issues w3ds://auth relies on the wallet to sign it (git grep w3ds://auth: 12 platforms, awareness-service, ppa, pp-auth-demo, w3ds-oidc-connector)

components.title: BlindVote
components.one_line: Pedersen-commitment voting library: private, publicly verifiable ballots.
evidence: platforms/evoting/api/package.json does not declare blindvote (undeclared workspace import)

components.title: Control panel
components.one_line: Admin SvelteKit app that monitors eVault pods, rate limits, references and notifications.

components.title: Dev sandbox
components.one_line: Browser stand-in for the eID wallet: provisions an identity, creates its UserProfile, signs auth and sign requests.
evidence: infrastructure/dev-sandbox/src/lib/userProfile.ts:19 writes the User ontology (same shape as the wallet: userProfile.ts:2)

components.title: Registry
components.one_line: Core service that resolves eNames/W3IDs to eVaults, issues entropy, certifies platforms, signs key-binding certificates, lists known platforms and whitelists notaries. Filed under platforms/ but is core infrastructure.
evidence: platforms/registry/api/src/index.ts:278-292 GET /platforms returns the base URLs of 11 platforms (not calendar, enotary, marketplace, profile-editor)
platforms/registry/api/src/index.ts:296 notary whitelist used by the wallet for recovery
every platform AuthController reads PUBLIC_REGISTRY_URL, e.g. platforms/blabsy/api/src/controllers/AuthController.ts:100; platforms/profile-editor/api/src/env.ts:25

components.title: Ontology service
components.one_line: Express server that serves the JSON schemas (schemaId → shape) every platform maps to; the schemas are the protocol's shared vocabulary.
evidence: each platform mapping names a schemaId from services/ontology/schemas (e.g. platforms/pictique/api/src/web3adapter/mappings/user.mapping.json)

components.title: User profile record (ontology User)
components.one_line: The person's profile (displayName, username, avatar, banner, bio, location) held once in their eVault; every platform that has users reads and edits this same record.
evidence: mapped by user.mapping.json in blabsy, pictique, cerberus, dreamsync, ecurrency, ereputation, esigner, evoting, file-manager, group-charter-manager (platforms/*/api/src/web3adapter/mappings/user.mapping.json)

PATCH /api/users updateProfile: platforms/pictique/api/src/index.ts:153, platforms/dreamsync/api/src/index.ts:118, platforms/ecurrency/api/src/index.ts:103, platforms/ereputation/api/src/index.ts:98, platforms/evoting/api/src/index.ts:193
platforms/blabsy/client/src/components/user/user-edit-profile.tsx:123 updateUserData (synced out by blabsy api user.mapping.json)
platforms/profile-editor/api/src/aaas.ts:71 getProfileEnvelopes reads it back through Awareness-as-a-Service

components.title: Professional profile record
components.one_line: CV-style profile (headline, experience, education, skills, CV and video file ids) beside the User record.

components.title: Group / chat record
components.one_line: A group or chat with its participants; the record nine platforms map their `groups` table to.
evidence: blabsy chat.mapping.json, pictique chat.mapping.json, and group.mapping.json in cerberus, dreamsync, ecurrency, ereputation, esigner, evoting, file-manager, group-charter-manager all name chat.json

components.title: Message record
components.one_line: A chat/group message; every adapter-backed platform maps a messages table to it (platforms post system messages into shared groups).
evidence: message.mapping.json in all ten adapter platforms (platforms/*/api/src/web3adapter/mappings/message.mapping.json; cerberus under client/)
byte-identical MessageService in ecurrency, esigner, file-manager (api/src/services/MessageService.ts)

components.title: Social media post record
components.one_line: A post or comment; Blabsy tweets and Pictique posts and comments are the same record.

components.title: File record
components.one_line: A stored file; File Manager and eSigner map the same files table to it, and w3ds://file URIs resolve to it.

components.title: File signature container record
components.one_line: Signatures over a file, shared by File Manager and eSigner.

components.title: Charter signature record
components.one_line: A member's signature on a group charter, written by Group Charter Manager and read by Cerberus.

components.title: Poll record
components.one_line: A poll; eVoting runs it and eReputation reads it for voting reputation.

components.title: Bookmark schema (used as voting observation / vote)
components.one_line: Cerberus voting observations and eReputation votes both map to the schemaId of bookmark.json — a reuse the names do not suggest; unknown whether intended.

components.title: Reference record (schemaId 550e8400-…-0010)
components.one_line: A signed reference about a person or platform; Cerberus writes them, eReputation owns them, marketplace, PPA and the control panel read them. No schema file in services/ontology/schemas carries this id.

components.title: Wishlist record (schemaId 770e8400-…-0000)
components.one_line: DreamSync wishes, also read by eReputation. No schema file in services/ontology/schemas carries this id.

components.title: Vote reputation result record (schemaId 660e8400-…-0102)
components.one_line: Reputation-weighted vote results shared by eVoting and eReputation. No schema file carries this id.

components.title: Post-platform scaffold (copied per platform, not a package)
components.one_line: The AuthController (w3ds://auth + signature-validator + JWT), WebhookController (awareness packet → local row, ANCHR forward), web3adapter watcher/subscriber, PlatformEVaultService and MaintenanceBanner that each platform carries its own diverged copy of.
evidence: controllers/AuthController.ts in 12 platforms, all with different md5 (e.g. platforms/blabsy/api/src/controllers/AuthController.ts, platforms/emover/api/src/controllers/AuthController.ts)

controllers/WebhookController.ts in 10 platforms, each posting to ANCHR_URL (platforms/blabsy/api/src/controllers/WebhookController.ts:93, platforms/pictique/api/src/controllers/WebhookController.ts:33)
web3adapter/watchers/subscriber.ts in 9 platforms, 356-660 lines, all diverged
services/PlatformEVaultService.ts in cerberus, dreamsync, ecurrency, esigner, file-manager (329-330 lines, all diverged)
MaintenanceBanner in blabsy (common/maintenance-banner.tsx), evoting, group-charter-manager, pictique reads registry status (platforms/evoting/client/src/components/MaintenanceBanner.tsx:20)
byte-identical api/src/utils/version.ts in blabsy, dreamsync, esigner, evoting, group-charter-manager, pictique

components.title: Copied shadcn/React UI kit
components.one_line: The same shadcn components copied byte-for-byte into the React clients of DreamSync, eReputation, Marketplace (and partly Calendar, Group Charter Manager, eVoting) instead of living in a package.
evidence: client/client/src/components/ui/*.tsx byte-identical in dreamsync, ereputation, marketplace (~40 files, e.g. button.tsx, dialog.tsx, sidebar.tsx)
card.tsx, form.tsx, sheet.tsx also identical in group-charter-manager; client/components/ui/avatar.tsx identical in calendar
client/hooks/use-mobile.tsx identical in 6 platforms incl. evoting

components.title: Blabsy
components.one_line: Twitter-like social platform (Next.js + Firebase client, W3DS auth/webhook API).

components.title: Pictique
components.one_line: Instagram-like social platform (SvelteKit client, Express API) with posts, comments, chats and profiles.

components.title: Profile Editor
components.one_line: Standalone platform for editing a person's User and Professional Profile records in their eVault and discovering other public profiles. Nothing imports, embeds or links to it; what is shared is the profile record it edits, which ten other platforms also read and write.
evidence: platforms/profile-editor/api/package.json depends on @metastate-foundation/auth, web3-adapter; client/package.json on @metastate-foundation/ui
platforms/profile-editor/client/src/lib/utils/file-manager.ts:29 uploads CV/video through File Manager; api/src/env.ts:38-41 FILE_MANAGER JWT

no reference to platforms/profile-editor from any other platform (git grep profile-editor outside the folder: only .env.example:115, platform-icons, eid-wallet PlatformAppCard.svelte:46, marketplace apps.json:76)
not in registry GET /platforms (platforms/registry/api/src/index.ts:278-292) nor in w3ds-gateway capabilities (packages/w3ds-gateway/src/capabilities.ts:35 lists only pictique, blabsy for User)

components.title: File Manager
components.one_line: Drive-like platform for files, folders, tags and signatures; also the file store Profile Editor uploads CVs and videos into.

components.title: eSigner
components.one_line: Document-signing platform; a fork of File Manager sharing its File and signature-container records.
evidence: byte-identical with file-manager: api/src/controllers/UserController.ts, api/src/services/S3Service.ts, client/src/routes/+layout.svelte, client/src/lib/stores/toast.ts

components.title: Group Charter Manager
components.one_line: Platform where a group writes and signs its charter; its charters are read by Cerberus and eVoting.
evidence: platforms/evoting/api/src/web3adapter/watchers/subscriber.ts:19 evoting's adapter declares platform = PUBLIC_GROUP_CHARTER_BASE_URL (likely a copy error: its writes are attributed to Group Charter Manager)

components.title: Cerberus
components.one_line: Headless bot platform (no UI despite the client/ folder) that watches group chats, enforces charters with an LLM and writes references to eReputation.
evidence: platforms/cerberus/client/package.json start = ts-node src/index.ts, depends only on web3-adapter

components.title: eVoting
components.one_line: Voting platform for groups, with blind (Pedersen) ballots and charter-aware polls.

components.title: eReputation
components.one_line: Reputation platform: signed references about people and platforms, voting reputation; the reference source Cerberus, Marketplace, PPA and the control panel read.

components.title: DreamSync
components.one_line: Matchmaking platform: wishlists and professional profiles matched by AI, with match notifications that link to Blabsy and Pictique.

components.title: eCurrency
components.one_line: Group currencies, accounts and ledgers stored as MetaEnvelopes; the worked example in the Post Platform Guide.

components.title: eMover
components.one_line: Platform that migrates a person's eVault to another provider; eVault core trusts it to skip webhooks during migration.
evidence: platforms/emover/api/package.json declares no workspace dependency (no web3-adapter)

components.title: Calendar
components.one_line: Calendar platform whose events live in the eVault, written through GraphQL directly rather than through the web3-adapter.
evidence: absent from registry /platforms, w3ds-gateway, platform-icons and README port list

components.title: eNotary
components.one_line: Notary platform that witnesses identities and issues recovery codes the wallet accepts for eVault recovery.

components.title: Marketplace
components.one_line: App catalogue of W3DS platforms, linked from the wallet, showing eReputation references and AaaS data.
evidence: platforms/marketplace/client/client/src/data/apps.json:76 lists Profile Editor as an app
README.md lists "5001 Marketplace Service" though the folder holds only client/

components.title: Awareness as a Service (AaaS)
components.one_line: Single fan-out point for eVault awareness packets: ingests from eVault core, stores, gates and delivers to platforms; portal issues API keys.

components.title: Post Platforms Association (PPA)
components.one_line: Reviewers vet platform releases and issue signed L1–L5 access decisions (certification).

components.title: PP Auth demonstrator
components.one_line: Demo of platform authentication (PP Auth) and domain separation built on @metastate-foundation/auth.

components.title: W3DS OIDC Connector
components.one_line: OpenID Connect provider whose login step is a W3DS wallet signature, so any OIDC IdP can offer Log in with W3DS.

components.title: Search engine
components.one_line: Searches cached registry entries and user profiles.

components.title: Trust score
components.one_line: Deterministic 0–10 trust score per eName.

components.title: Webhook inlet (test)
components.one_line: Tiny Express server that logs every webhook it receives.

components.title: Notification trigger
components.one_line: Push-notification sender (APNS/FCM). Its README calls it a toy kept for testing, but eVault core and the control panel call it to deliver real pushes.

components.title: @metastate-foundation/auth
components.one_line: Platform-authentication library: login verification, PP Auth release chains, delegated (company) signatures, eName normalisation. Described as shared by platform APIs but only Profile Editor among platforms uses it.
evidence: packages/auth/package.json description "Shared authentication utilities for w3ds platform APIs"; depends on delegation, signature-validator

components.title: @metastate-foundation/delegation
components.one_line: Company signing delegation: scopes, signed payload formats and chain evaluation.

components.title: @metastate-foundation/types
components.one_line: Shared W3DS types for binding documents and related structures.

components.title: wallet-sdk
components.one_line: Bring-your-own-crypto SDK for provisioning, authentication and public-key sync; the wallet logic the eID wallet and dev sandbox share.

components.title: @metastate-foundation/ui
components.one_line: Svelte component library. Despite the generic name only Profile Editor uses it; the React platforms carry copied shadcn kits instead.

components.title: @metastate-foundation/platform-icons
components.one_line: Brand icons keyed by platform subdomain (KNOWN_PLATFORM_ICONS); consumed only by the eID wallet.

components.title: w3ds-gateway
components.one_line: Resolves an eName + schemaId to the platforms that can open it and shows an 'Open with…' chooser. No workspace package imports it (only test.html at the root).

components.title: @repo/eslint-config
components.one_line: Turborepo ESLint presets; no package depends on it.
evidence: git grep "@repo/eslint-config" finds only its own package.json

components.title: @repo/typescript-config
components.one_line: Turborepo tsconfig presets; no package depends on it.
evidence: git grep "@repo/typescript-config" finds only its own package.json

components.title: Dockerfiles
components.one_line: Dockerfiles for the eight services that ship containers (blabsy, blabsy api, dev-sandbox, evault-core, pictique, pictique api, registry, oidc connector).

components.title: Database compose
components.one_line: Postgres + Neo4j for local development; the only compose file in the repo (the profiles README describes are not present).
evidence: git ls-files finds no other docker-compose file

components.title: Company delegation demo
components.one_line: Runnable demo of signing for a company through directors, roles and delegations.

components.title: Staging load tests
components.one_line: Load tests against staging Blabsy, Pictique, registry and provisioner.

components.title: Documentation site
components.one_line: Docusaurus site at docs.w3ds.metastate.foundation: W3DS Basics, Protocol, Infrastructure, Services, GitW3, Post Platform Guide.

components.title: W3DS agent skill
components.one_line: Agent skill (SKILL.md + reference pages) served from the docs site so coding agents stop guessing.
